services.seoTitle: How car painting and bodywork work at Mpaint

seoSteps.p: Before painting, we assess the extent of the damage, the condition of the body panel and the existing paint. If needed, we remove rust, repair dents, and prepare the surface with sanding, priming and other preparatory work.
The paint is chosen to match the car's factory colour code and existing shade. We paint individual body parts such as bumpers, doors, wings and bonnets, as well as larger body surfaces and full cars.
Alongside car painting, we carry out body repair, welding, rust damage repair, dent removal, part replacement and polishing. The scope of work depends on the car's condition and the type of damage.

faq.q: Can a scratch be repaired without repainting the whole panel?
faq.a: Sometimes, yes. It depends on how deep the scratch is and the condition of the paint layer.

faq.q: Can a dent be removed without repainting?
faq.a: Yes, if the paint layer is intact and the damage allows for paintless dent removal.

faq.q: How is rust damage repaired?
faq.a: We remove the affected area, repair the metal if needed, and prepare the surface for repainting.

faq.q: Can a rusted part always be repaired?
faq.a: Not always. A severely damaged or fully rusted-through part may need partial or full replacement.

faq.q: How is the new paint matched to the existing colour?
faq.a: We start from your car's factory colour code and check the tone against the existing paintwork.

faq.q: Can plastic bumpers be repaired and painted?
faq.a: Yes. Whether it's possible depends on the extent of any cracks, deformation, or other damage.

faq.q: Do you also paint whole cars?
faq.a: Yes, we paint individual parts as well as larger areas and full cars.

faq.q: What's done before painting?
faq.a: The surface is cleaned, sanded, repaired and primed according to its condition.

faq.q: What bodywork services do you offer?
faq.a: We repair dents, rust and body damage, carry out welding, and prepare surfaces for painting.

faq.q: How long does the work take?
faq.a: It depends on the extent of the damage, the preparation needed, and the scope of the repair.

paint.tagline: Full resprays and single panels, painted in our own filtered booth.
paint.intro: Painting a single panel takes 3-4 days on average, a full respray takes over a month. Most of that time goes into taking the car apart and putting it back together, not the paint drying.
bullets: Dust-free finish in our own booth
techNotes: We use several quality paint brands, preferring an exact colour match from one specific manufacturer. For trickier cases, we do a spectrophotometer test spray before the full repaint.
Metallic and pearl finishes cost more, since pearl needs two coats of paint.
paint.pricingNote: Painting a panel from 250€, bonnet and roof from 450€.

secondarySection.heading: Bumper painting
secondarySection.text: The bumper is one of the most commonly painted single parts. Painting plastic bumpers needs slightly different prep than metal panels — the plastic surface needs an adhesion primer so the paint holds properly. Pricing stays in the same range as any other single part, from 250€.

faq.q: Can a scratch be fixed without repainting the part?
faq.a: Sometimes — if the scratch is surface-level and the paint layer is intact, polishing is often enough. If the scratch goes through the paint or down to the metal, it needs painting.

faq.q: Can plastic bumpers be repaired and painted?
faq.a: Yes. Whether it's possible depends on the crack, deformation, and extent of the damage.

faq.q: Do you paint whole cars too?
faq.a: Yes, we do everything from single parts to larger panels and full-car resprays.

faq.q: What's done before painting?
faq.a: The surface is cleaned, sanded, repaired where needed, and primed according to its condition.

body.tagline: Structural repair and sheet-metal work for any make or model.
body.intro: Cosmetic damage doesn't need special equipment. Structural damage, such as through-corrosion, needs either a part replacement or welding in a repair panel.
techNotes: If the metal's too thin for the spotter, we use either chemical thinning or tin thinning, choosing the technique based on the situation.
We also restore plastic body parts with structural epoxy paint and fit panels to match the gaps.
body.warningNote: We don't do frame pulling on a bench, full sill replacement, or take on oversized vehicles.

faq.q: What bodywork do you do?
faq.a: We handle dent, rust and body damage repair, welding work, and prep for painting.

dent.tagline: Paintless spotter repair. Faster and cheaper than replacing the panel.
dent.intro: If the metal isn't torn and the paint isn't broken, most dents can be pulled out with the spotter method without repainting. Keeping the original factory paint also means the car's value drops less than it would after a repainted panel.
bullets: No repainting needed in most cases
Cheaper than a full panel swap
We use the spotter method to pull dents out. If the damage is too deep for the spotter, we assess it for free and offer an alternative.

faq.q: Can a dent be removed without painting?
faq.a: Yes, if the paint layer is intact and the damage allows for paintless dent repair.

rust.tagline: Stop corrosion before it spreads. We clean, treat, and protect.
rust.intro: Damaged metal is cleaned, treated with acid to remove invisible corrosion, and protected with multiple layers of primer before painting.
process: Cleaning the damaged area before pressure washing
Treating the metal with phosphoric acid to remove invisible corrosion
bullets: Full cleaning & treatment of the affected area
Often paired with a colour-matched respray
rust.pricingNote: From 50€, depending on the extent and depth of the damage and how accessible it is.
rust.warningNote: Sometimes corrosion has spread too far for the metal to be repaired. In that case, we recommend replacement.

secondarySection.heading: Preventive rust protection
secondarySection.text: We also offer preventive rust protection for newer cars, especially given Estonia's winter road salt.

faq.q: How does rust damage repair work?
faq.a: We remove the damaged area, repair the metal where needed, and prepare the surface for repainting.

faq.q: Can a rusted part always be repaired?
faq.a: Not always. A heavily damaged or fully rusted-through part may need a partial or full replacement.

polish.tagline: Removes light scratches and restores headlight clarity.
polish.intro: For headlight restoration we use both chemical and mechanical methods, depending on the condition of the coating. Polishing only helps with surface-level scratches — if a scratch goes down to the paint layer, the part needs repainting.

faq.q: Does polishing remove all scratches?
faq.a: Only surface-level ones. If a scratch goes down to the paint layer, the part needs painting — see our car painting service.

parts.tagline: Damaged or worn parts found, sourced, and fitted.
parts.intro: Before starting any work, we assess whether a damaged part is worth repairing or better off replaced. If it needs replacing, we offer both new and used parts, depending on your budget and the car's age.
bullets: Full diagnosis before any work starts
New or used parts, your choice
Used parts available to save money

faq.q: Do you use new or used parts?
faq.a: Both — it's your choice. Used parts are the cheaper option; new parts make sense if you want to keep things factory-original.

meta.description: Mpaint price list in Tallinn: painting a panel from 250€, rust protection from 50€. Pricing for other work depends on the damage — request a free quote.

pricing.intro: The final price always depends on the extent of the damage, how much work is needed, and the condition of the car. Below are our confirmed starting prices — for the other services we give a more exact quote once we have seen the damage.
pricing.genericNote: Price depends on the extent of the damage and the work involved. Request a free quote.

faq.q: Why is there no fixed price for every service?
faq.a: Most of our work, such as bodywork, dent removal, polishing and parts replacement, depends directly on the extent of the damage and the condition of the car. We can only give an exact price once we have seen it.

faq.q: Is getting a quote free?
faq.a: Yes, requesting a quote costs nothing.

warranty.title: Warranty
warranty.text: Up to 1 year warranty on most work. The warranty doesn't apply if we didn't carry out the preparation work, or if rust repair was done at the client's request rather than our recommendation.

contact.seoP2: We speak Estonian, Russian and English. Phone and WhatsApp are the quickest way to reach us during the working day, and email is best if you want to attach several photos or an insurance case number.
contact.hoursP: Monday to Friday from 9:00 to 19:00. Saturday by agreement, so call ahead. Closed on Sunday.
